purpose: The separator models the stems stage may use, each with its MEASURED SDR, its licence and its exact artefact URLs. This file exists so no separator is ever chosen from recollection or from a search snippet: on 2026-08-14 the Kim Vocal checkpoint was picked on LICENCE while its SDR was quoted from a snippet, and reading the real table (this session) showed it is SECOND, not first. Recorded as D-SSM-28.

models.why_refused: MEASURED 2026-08-15: the string `polarformer` appears in NO model_type branch of `utils/model_utils.py`, neither in the v1.0.21 release I staged (23 model_type branches enumerated: mdx23c, htdemucs, segm_models, torchseg, mel_band_roformer, mel_band_conformer, mel_band_roformer_experimental, bs_roformer, bs_conformer, bs_roformer_experimental, bs_mamba2, swin_upernet, bandit, bandit_v2, scnet_unofficial, scnet, scnet_tran, apollo, experimental_mdx23c_stht, scnet_masked, conformer, moises_light) nor on the CURRENT main branch (fetched this session: 0 matches in model_utils.py, 0 in settings.py). Its own config carries no `model_type` key either. So the checkpoint cannot be RUN by this inference code, and the table row is capability-on-paper — the printed-enum class this project has been burned by four times. The A/B is therefore NOT DONE and is NOT claimed; reviving it needs either an inference implementation for that architecture or an upstream release that adds the branch.
